overviewHtml:
Unlimited log queries can drive up costs fast, and a few heavy users are often responsible. Admins need an automatic guardrail instead of manual monitoring.

What you get

  • Every-minute check of each user's daily log-query volume from billing events
  • Configurable threshold, 10 TB by default
  • Over-quota users added to an IAM group that denies log reads
  • Email notification and a business event for auditing and de-duplication
  • Automatic reset at midnight UTC, or manual early unlock
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS tenant with Automation Workflows and the dynatrace.email connector enabled
  • Account Management access to create IAM policies, groups, service users, and OAuth clients
  • The dynatrace.automations ^1.3208.0 and dynatrace.email ^1.10.8 apps available in your environment

See SETUP.md for the full step-by-step instructions.
setupHtml:
The setup takes roughly 15 minutes and involves six steps:

  1. Create two IAM policies — one to deny log reads, one for the workflow to run with
  2. Create the "Quota exceeded" group and attach the deny policy
  3. [OPTIONAL (Recommened)]Create a service user "Quota Exceeded Check User" as the workflow actor
  4. Create an OAuth client (requires an account manager as the subject user)
  5. Store the OAuth credentials in the Credential Vault as "Quota check OAuth"
  6. Import workflow.yaml and set the actor to the service user
getStartedHtml:
You need Automation Workflows, the email connector, and Account Management access.

  1. Create the IAM policies and the quota-exceeded group
  2. Create an OAuth client and store it in the Credential Vault
  3. Import the workflow and set its actor

Full setup instructions are in the README.
